sections.title: Information security
sections.description: How systems are protected. Best answered by the security or IT lead.

questions.label: Is multi-factor login (MFA) required for email?
Is MFA required for all remote access (VPN, remote desktop)?
Is MFA required for admin and privileged accounts?
Do you run endpoint detection and response (EDR) on all devices?
Which EDR product?
Are backups kept offline or unchangeable (immutable)?
When were backups last test-restored?
How quickly are critical security patches applied?
Do you run any software that no longer gets security updates?
Which software, and how is it protected?
Do staff get phishing training at least once a year?
Do you have a tested incident response plan?
Are factory or operational systems (OT) kept apart from the office network?
Do you use SWIFT or other payment networks?
Name and job title of the security lead
